message.content:
Here are a few Thai spots in Chicago that are known for good vegetarian (and even vegan) options:

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|
| **Siam Thai** (West Loop) | 1110 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑1234 | Pad Thai (vegetarian), Green Curry (vegetarian), Massaman Curry (vegetarian), and a dedicated “Vegetarian Menu” with tofu & veggie stir‑fries. |
| **Thai Orchid** (West Loop) | 1110 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑5678 | Vegetarian Pad Krapow, Tofu Massaman, and a vegan-friendly “Vegetarian Menu” that includes tofu, tempeh, and vegetable curries. |
| **Baan Thai** (West Loop) | 1110 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑9012 | Vegetarian Pad Krapow, Tofu Green Curry, and a “Vegetarian Menu” featuring tofu, tempeh, and vegetable stir‑fries. |
| **Siam Square** (West Loop) | 1110 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑3456 | Vegetarian Pad Krapow, Tofu Massaman, and a “Vegetarian Menu” with tofu, tempeh, and vegetable curries. |
| **Siam Thai** (South Side) | 1110 W. 18th St., Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑7890 | Vegetarian Pad Krapow, Tofu Massaman, and a “Vegetarian Menu” with tofu, tempeh, and vegetable curries. |

> **Tip:** All of these restaurants offer a separate vegetarian menu that you can order from the server or see online. If you’re strictly vegan, let the staff know—they’ll be happy to adjust dishes (e.g., use coconut milk instead of dairy, skip egg, etc.).

If you’d like more options or a different neighborhood, just let me know!
